Package edu.mit.rocket_team.util

package edu.mit.rocket_team.util
Common instrument/controller interfaces, firmware state codes, virtual clock/log utilities and the bridge to per-run rocket actuators. Angles cross the bridge in degrees for FC commands and radians for physical fin APIs.
